label: Agunea Limit
summary: Holding Agunea now stops after the first lightning strike plus at most five paid extra strikes (six total) instead of continuing while hearts last.

edits.why: EntitySubwpnAgunea step 3: load-delay nop -> lh $t0,0x7c($s1) (strike frame counter ext.agunea.unk7C)
load-delay nop -> sltiu $t0,$t0,0x48 (counter < 72 = 6 strikes x 12 frames)
load-delay nop -> beqz $t0,0x80128F14 (counter reached limit: step=2, end before the next strike spends hearts)

vanilla.reason: The three replaced words are nops in vanilla too and the new code only uses the Agunea entity ($s1) and the unused temp $t0; no other ASS code is involved.

tunables.why: Strike limit: int16 LE immediate of `sltiu $t0,$t0,N` (N = 0x48 = 72). A strike happens every 12 frames of ext.agunea.unk7C starting at 0, so total strikes = ceil(N/12) (72 -> 6 = 1 initial + 5 extra); extra strikes = N/12 - 1 when N is a multiple of 12.

overlaps.detail: No other hack or PPF writes 0x88EC8-0x88EEB (o->a diffs in EntitySubwpnAgunea 0x80128C2C-0x801291C4 come only from this patch).

overlaps.hack: stray: Agunea-Succession-50-Hearts.ppf (not part of this toggle)
overlaps.detail: See notes: its only byte, DRA 0x85B8E 0x05->0x32, is in func_80125B6C (Holy Water side-wall collision), not in Agunea; it is deliberately excluded from this spec.

notes: Source: Agunea-Five-Extra-Lightning-Strikes.ppf + manifest/README (Codex 2026-09-29/s). v == o == 00000000 at all three words; a matches the manifest. Decomp: src/dra/84B88.c EntitySubwpnAgunea case 3: strikes at unk7C % 12 == 0, extra strikes cost heartCost=5 (vanilla `ori $s0,$zero,5` at 0x89000, untouched). The new check runs only when unk7C != 0 (it sits after the `beqz unk7C` branch) and $t0 is not used anywhere else in the function. Agunea-Succession-50-Hearts.ppf (Codex 2026-09-28/s) is NOT part of this hack: its builder read an unaligned word at 0x85B8E; the aligned instruction is 0x85B8C `sll $a0,$a1,16` (00052400) and the patch makes it 00322400 = `sll $a0,$s2,16` with a non-zero rs field (R3000/emulators ignore rs for SLL). That function is func_80125B6C(y,x), called only from EntitySubwpnHolyWater (0x80125D5C) to test side walls at posX+x; it now uses the low half of $s2 (left over from the entity-update caller; EntitySubwpnHolyWater does not set s2) instead of +-4, so Holy Water's in-flight side-wall check probes a wrong X (likely flying through walls). It has no effect on Agunea's cost. Recommendation: leave it out of every toggle; optionally offer a separate fix that restores DRA 0x85B8E = 0x05 (vanilla). The 100-heart initial cost / 80 ATK of Agunea are stat-table values and are not part of this toggle.
